title: Uni-ViGU: Unified Video Generation and Understanding
summary: Uni-ViGU is a unified framework that extends a diffusion-based video generator to perform both video generation and understanding tasks. It utilizes a modality-driven Mixture-of-Experts architecture and a unified flow matching mechanism to integrate continuous video and discrete text modalities.
research_notes: Built on the Wan2.1 Diffusion Transformer architecture; introduces specialized Feed-Forward Network experts to handle different modalities within a single flow.

evolution.summary: Initial release in April 2026; the project demonstrates a shift towards using video generators like Wan2.1 as a foundation for multimodal intelligence instead of extending large language models.
